description: Open a persistent PTY interactive session to run [interactive/program that requires real TTY] (msfconsole/ssh interactive/mysql, python, etc. REPL/password prompt/nc session), and return session_id. **Use Bash for one-time, non-interactive commands**. mode: interactive=block until the first prompt/silent and then return to the startup output; hands-free (default)=return immediately, and then poll with shell_read; dispatch=return immediately, and send a notification when completed; monitor=return immediately, and send a notification when the watch keyword is hit in the background (the session does not end, and only survives this run). You can set prompt_regex (such as 'msf6? >\s*$') to accurately determine the completion. Be sure to shell_close when finished.
name: shell_open

command.description: Interactive program to run, such as 'msfconsole -q' / 'ssh user@host' / 'python3'

prompt_regex.description: Optional: Prompt regular for command completion judgment (match the end of the output)

quiet_ms.description: Optional: How many milliseconds of silence is considered complete (default 8000)

startup_grace_ms.description: Optional: Start grace milliseconds, no silent judgment is triggered during this period (default 15000)

watch.description: Monitor mode is required: Keywords/regular array to be monitored, if any one is hit in the output, a notification will be sent (each will be reported only once)

description: Send input to an interactive session: text/submit/keys/hex/paste can be combined and sent in the order of appearance (see the fields for the meaning of each parameter). wait=true (default) waits for the command to complete and brings back incremental output.
name: shell_send

hex.description: Hexadecimal of raw bytes, such as ['0x1b','0x5b','0x41']

paste.description: Multi-line paste (bracketed paste, does not trigger line-by-line execution)

prompt_regex.description: Optional: Override the session's default completion prompt

submit.description: Whether to append a carriage return after the text for execution

text.description: Text to be entered (without automatic carriage return)

timeout_ms.description: Optional: Hard timeout for wait in milliseconds (default 120000)

wait.description: Whether to wait until the command is completed synchronously (default true)

description: Read the output of an interactive session (without sending input). view=stream (default) incremental original stream (streaming preferred, continuous reading/can be drained to get the full amount); view=screen full screen vt snapshot (suitable for full screen programs such as vim/htop).
name: shell_read

drain.description: stream: true=Return all original streams since last time (ignoring upper limit)

max_bytes.description: stream: maximum number of bytes returned (default 8192)

max_lines.description: stream: Maximum number of lines returned (default 200)

since_cursor.description: stream: read from after the cursor; if not passed, use the session internal cursor to continue reading.

description: Close an interactive session (kill process, release PTY).
name: shell_close

description: List all current interactive sessions and status.
name: shell_list
